recipes.prompt: A straight-on 4:3 empty handmade felt puppet theater stage for a premium preschool game. Keep the central 70 percent calm, open and dark enough for colorful puppet cards and a sentence strip. Tactile wool fibers, blanket stitching, softly stuffed applique, warm studio light from upper left, dimensional but not photorealistic. No characters, words, letters, cards, buttons, logo or watermark. Fill the canvas edge to edge; no outer frame or transparent margin.
recipes.accepted: Clean stage plate with the intended quiet center, lighting and material system.

recipes.prompt: A single centered padded plum-felt title plaque for a premium handmade preschool puppet-theater game. Cream felt applique lettering must spell exactly, on three centered lines: SILLY / SENTENCE / BUILDER. Large playful rounded letters, each fully readable, with mustard blanket stitching, two tiny teal and coral felt stars, tactile wool fibers and warm upper-left light. Isolated object, straight-on, generous breathing room, no other words, no logo, no watermark. Then precisely remove only the outside background to true transparency while preserving the plaque, lettering, stitches, fibers, shadows and exact spelling.
recipes.accepted: Exact spelling and real outside alpha verified at full size and on saturated magenta.
